description: Systematically harvest short testimonials from customers via NPS, milestones, post-purchase, and email during PRD v1.0 Market Adoption. Triggers on requests to collect testimonials, set up social proof harvest, gather customer quotes, or when user asks "how do we get testimonials?", "social proof harvest", "NPS responses", "testimonial wall", "customer quotes", "post-purchase survey", "milestone follow-up". Outputs CFD-TST-* testimonial entries and GTM-TST-* placement assets.
